# Helio Software Q2 Call

## Enterprise retention

Large customers renewed multi-year contracts and expanded seat counts. Enterprise net retention reached one hundred eighteen percent.

## AI bookings

The assistant product generated twelve million dollars of new annual contract value. Most buyers added it to existing platform contracts.

## Guidance

Helio raised its subscription revenue forecast. Sales expense will increase during the second half.
